# komodo_alerter (Resource)

Manages a Komodo alerter, which routes alerts (server unreachable, container state changes, failed builds, ...) to an endpoint such as Slack, Discord, ntfy, Pushover or a custom HTTP receiver. Maintenance windows are not managed by this resource and are left untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send every alert to a Discord channel.
resource "komodo_alerter" "discord" {
  name = "discord"
  endpoint = {
    type = "Discord"
    url  = var.discord_webhook_url
  }
}

# Send only server and stack problems to ntfy, and leave one noisy stack out.
resource "komodo_alerter" "ntfy_critical" {
  name = "ntfy-critical"
  endpoint = {
    type  = "Ntfy"
    url   = "https://ntfy.example.com/komodo"
    email = "ops@example.com"
  }

  alert_types = [
    "ServerUnreachable",
    "ServerDisk",
    "StackStateChange",
    "BuildFailed",
  ]

  except_resources = [
    { type = "Stack", id = komodo_stack.scratch.id },
  ]

  tags = ["prod"]
}

# POST alerts as JSON to your own receiver. Created disabled.
resource "komodo_alerter" "custom" {
  name    = "custom-receiver"
  enabled = false
  endpoint = {
    type = "Custom"
    url  = "http://alert-receiver.internal:7000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (Attributes) Where alerts are sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint))
- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `alert_types` (List of String) Only send these alert types. Empty or unset sends all types. Valid values: Test, SwarmUnhealthy, ServerUnreachable, ServerCpu, ServerMem, ServerDisk, ServerVersionMismatch, ContainerStateChange, DeploymentImageUpdateAvailable, DeploymentAutoUpdated, StackStateChange, StackImageUpdateAvailable, StackAutoUpdated, AwsBuilderTerminationFailed, ResourceSyncPendingUpdates, BuildFailed, RepoBuildFailed, ProcedureFailed, ActionFailed, ScheduleRun, Custom.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alerter sends alerts. Defaults to true (Komodo's own default for a new alerter is false).
- `except_resources` (Attributes List) Never send alerts about these resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--except_resources))
- `resources` (Attributes List) Only send alerts about these resources. Empty or unset sends alerts for all resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `tags` (List of String) List of tag names to apply to this alerter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoint`

Required:

- `type` (String) Endpoint type. One of: Custom, Slack, Discord, Ntfy, Pushover. Custom POSTs the alert as JSON to the URL.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Endpoint URL: the Slack or Discord webhook URL, the ntfy topic URL, the Pushover messages URL including its token and user parameters, or the HTTP endpoint for Custom.

Optional:

- `email` (String) Ntfy only: e-mail address for ntfy e-mail notifications. SMTP must be configured on the ntfy server.


<a id="nestedatt--except_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `except_resources`

Required:

- `id` (String) Komodo ID of the resource (for example komodo_stack.app.id).
- `type` (String) Resource type. One of: Swarm, Server, Stack, Deployment, Build, Repo, Procedure, Action, Builder, Alerter, ResourceSync.


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Required:

- `id` (String) Komodo ID of the resource (for example komodo_stack.app.id).
- `type` (String) Resource type. One of: Swarm, Server, Stack, Deployment, Build, Repo, Procedure, Action, Builder, Alerter, ResourceSync.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing alerter by its Komodo ID.
terraform import komodo_alerter.discord 65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1
```
